lines.say: Your heart stops. Here's what science says happens next.
Ten to twenty seconds. Blood stops reaching the brain, you lose consciousness, and standard brain recordings go flat.
But flat on the surface doesn't mean nothing is happening. In some dying brains, short bursts of organized activity have been recorded.
shots: line art: hidden spikes under flat line

lines.say: Around four to six minutes without oxygen, brain cells start to suffer serious damage.
Yet during CPR, a 2023 study found near-normal brain waves reappearing even up to an hour in.
And doctors have revived people after much longer, especially in freezing cold, where the brain needs less oxygen.
Death isn't a switch. It's a process. And where in that process a person stops being there, nobody can say yet.
